noDisks.title: Connect your drives
noDisks.text: When you connect them, I'll compare them and tell you what needs doing.

oneDisk.title: {present} is connected
oneDisk.text: Connect {missing} too, so I can make them the same. Meanwhile you can copy your files to {present}, as usual.

inSync.title: Your drives are the same
inSync.text: Your files are safe on both drives.

status.foreign: {name} belongs to another pair of drives: I won't touch it.

summary.title: Here's what I'll do

title.one: I have a question for you

questions.text: Deleted files, or files changed on both drives: you decide.

summary.onlyQuestions: Everything else is already the same.
summary.noSpace: {disk} needs {size} more space. Free some up and connect the drives again.

conflict.text: This file was changed on both drives, in different ways.
conflict.bothHint: The version on {disk} will be called “{name}”.

questions.folderHint: The whole folder, with everything in it.

syncing.title: Copying…
syncing.text: You can close this window: I'll carry on by myself.
syncing.etaUnknown: Working out how long it will take…

skipped.one: I couldn't copy 1 file: I'll try again next time.
skipped.other: I couldn't copy {count} files: I'll try again next time.

due.title: Time to check that your files are healthy
due.text: I'll re-read every file on both drives, to find out if any got damaged. It will take about {time}.
due.textUnknown: I'll re-read every file on both drives, to find out if any got damaged.

running.title: Checking your files…
running.text: You can keep using your computer. You can even unplug the drives: I'll pick up from here next time.

repairs.one: 1 file got damaged on {disk}. Shall I repair it using {other}?
repairs.other: {count} files got damaged on {disk}. Shall I repair them using {other}?

lost.one: 1 file is damaged on both drives and can't be repaired:
lost.other: {count} files are damaged on both drives and can't be repaired:

check.paused: Check paused: I'll pick up from here next time.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.disconnected: {disk} was unplugged. Plug it back in to continue: I'll pick up where I left off.
error.no_space: There isn't enough space on {disk}. Free some up and connect the drives again.
error.read_only: I can't write to the drive. If it's formatted for Windows (NTFS), a Mac can only read it.
error.eject: I can't eject {disk}: a file may still be open. Close the programs using it and try again.
error.other: Something unexpected happened. Unplug and reconnect the drives, then try again.

settings.namesHint: A name that helps you tell them apart, like “Red drive”.
settings.checkNowHint: Connect both drives to check them.
settings.title: Settings
